security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown backticks, code fences, app identifiers, or documentation links. Real residual risk comes from visible external belt commands, the broad Bash(belt *) permission, and third-party handling of queries or extracted content. No prompt injection language or covert credential access was found.

remediation.suggestion: Replace Bash(belt *) with narrower allowed commands for the documented Tavily, Exa, and OpenRouter workflows.
Add a clear warning that queries, URLs, extracted pages, and prompts may be sent to third-party hosted services.
Pin or verify recommended skill install sources and explain the trust boundary before users run npx skills add commands.

content.value_statement: Research tasks need current sources and clean page content. This skill connects Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to Tavily and Exa through belt.
actual_capabilities: Run Tavily Search Assistant queries through the belt CLI.
Extract clean text and images from one or more URLs with Tavily Extract.
Run Exa search for relevant links with context.
Ask Exa Answer for direct factual answers.
Extract and analyze a single web page with Exa Extract.
Chain search or extraction results into Claude models through OpenRouter apps.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh belt CLI and any needed service authentication.
Search quality and availability depend on Tavily, Exa, and inference.sh services.
Queries, URLs, and extracted content may leave the local environment.
It does not independently verify facts returned by search providers.

use_cases.title: Prepare Research Briefs
use_cases.description: Collect current source links and summaries before writing a market, policy, or technical brief.

use_cases.title: Prototype RAG Retrieval
use_cases.description: Fetch web context for RAG prototypes without building a custom search integration.

use_cases.title: Compare Source Coverage
use_cases.description: Extract article content and compare source coverage for editorial planning.

prompt_templates.title: Search for Recent Sources
prompt_templates.prompt: Search the web for recent reliable sources about [topic]. Return the main answer, source links, and publication dates when available.

prompt_templates.title: Extract a Web Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the main content from [URL]. Summarize the key points and include any source title or image information returned.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Search Providers
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Tavily and Exa for [topic]. Compare the strongest sources, note disagreements, and identify gaps for manual review.

prompt_templates.title: Build a RAG Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for [topic], extract the most relevant pages, then prepare a source brief for a RAG ingestion workflow.

output_examples.input: Search for current AI agent evaluation methods.
output_examples.output: A short answer with source links, context snippets, and notes on evaluation frameworks mentioned across results.

output_examples.input: Extract the article at a public URL.
output_examples.output: Clean page text, detected images, and a concise summary of the article content.

output_examples.input: Compare Tavily and Exa results for a technical topic.
output: Overlapping sources and unique sources from each provider.
A short synthesis of agreements, conflicts, and follow-up questions.

best_practices: Review returned source links before using results in final work.
Do not send secrets, private documents, or internal URLs to external search tools.
Use extraction after search when you need full article context.
anti_patterns: Treating generated answers as verified facts without checking sources.
Submitting sensitive customer data or unreleased work as search queries.
Using broad web results as a substitute for domain-specific databases.

faq.question: What services does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses Tavily and Exa through the inference.sh belt CLI.

faq.question: Does it require setup?
faq.answer: Yes. You need the belt CLI, service access, and login where required.

faq.question: Can it browse any web page?
faq.answer: No. Provider limits, robots rules, paywalls, and page access can affect extraction.

faq.question: Does it store search results locally?
faq.answer: The examples may redirect results to local files, but the skill itself is documentation.

faq.question: Is it safe for confidential research?
faq.answer: Use caution. Queries, URLs, and extracted text may be sent to third-party services.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
